title: ClearPath Seat Volume and the TimeBank Repeat-Order Percentage
content:
**Repeat-order seat schedule.** On a repeat order of a TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours block, a client whose active ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement covers at least 50 seats earns 2 percent, one whose active agreement covers at least 25 and fewer than 50 seats earns 1 percent, and any other client earns none. The percentage is granted to the repeat-order price. The seats are the named users the active ClearPath agreement currently covers, as its record shows.

| Seats covered by the active ClearPath agreement | Percentage |
|---|---|
| 50 or more | 2 |
| 25 to 49 | 1 |
| fewer than 25 | none |
| no active ClearPath agreement | none |

Hypothetical boundary cases: 49 seats earns 1 percent and 50 seats earns 2; 24 seats earns none and 25 earns 1.
